svg.title: One blocked and one granted command
svg.desc: A client requests a nozzle temperature of 300 °C, and because the nozzle maximum is 260 °C the safety kernel blocks the request and the hub returns error -32010 LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The client then requests a bed temperature of 70 °C, every check passes, the kernel issues a single-use grant, the driver consumes the grant and sets the bed heater, and the hub returns a result.
